name: A Twisted Little Hunt
author: CharlieOakh
bootlegger: In addition to their Minion ability, the Alchemist also has the ability to guess who the evil Damsel is. The Alchemist does not register to a good Damsel.
If the Boffin grants the Demon the Huntsman ability, this will add an evil Damsel into the game. The Demon will turn an evil Damsel into a not-in-play Minion if they choose the evil Damsel at night.
If an evil Damsel is added into the game, the Alchemist, if in play, will be informed. Minions will not be informed, and will not register to the evil Damsel.
